notes.title: Carwyn Gets a Makeover in the New Femboy Update!
notes.notes:
Since time immemorial man has looked to the sky man and thought, "damn, femboys are hot.". Well we've heard you! The promised, then cancelled, then re-promised Femboy Carwyn update is here! And just look how cute he is!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/854c221c1062bd66a500cd1807aebdc1c3117ce0.png"]  

This update adds four variations of a new route in Netoria Tactics: Revolution Gold. Once femboy-ized Carwyn can have relationships with Gwenivier, Vivian, Owain, or Kobold Joe. Yes that's right, Kobold Joe has a route he's involved in for the first time ever. And yes, writing sex scenes in his accent was hard. But now NTR fans and sexy-kobold-fucking-femboys fans can stand hand in hand with one game that units them. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/e86ec8bf41c5d1c81e3dee3e432578ad90add6b2.png"]

This is the last big update to Netoria Tactics: Revolution. For more SRPG tactics fun, be sure to wishlist Netoria Tactics 2! It also has femboys.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906595/f2920d5b20de80ee684ade99ff6463e6cfc3718f.png"]

Changelog: 

Added femboy class and transformation for Carwyn

Added femboy variant route of Carwyn-Gwenivier love route

Added femboy variant route of Carwyn-Vivian route

Added Carwyn-Owain route

Added Carwyn-Kobold Joe route

Added gropes for femboy Carwyn and the above partners.

Added new bonus scene with femboy Carwyn blowing Owain, Emrys, and Mordrid.

18 total new sex scenes added,

Added the ability to extend the story mode skip to all map segments, not just battles.

Remade the recollection room, removing walls and compacting it to fit on one screen.

notes.title: Bug Fix and Art Update
notes.notes:
Reworked all the party member sprites.
Fixed a bug that caused players to be forced onto the wrong endings.
Fixed a bug where Vivian could die before Carwyn rescued her and never join the party.
Fixed a bug where entering the grope chamber in the recollection room would result in a game over.
The Steam bonus items are now only usable on Normal and easier difficulties
